metadata.description: Skills that teach an agent how to reach a human through PingRoom — pings, files, locations, questions, approvals, handoffs, and lock-screen live progress.

plugins.name: pingroom-mcp
plugins.description: Reach a human from a conversational session over the hosted PingRoom MCP connector: send pings with locations, links, structured data and small attachments; ask a question and block on the answer; gate an action on an approval; hand a decision to your authorizing human; drive a lock-screen live-progress card. Installing it wires up the MCP server as well as the skill — you authenticate once via /mcp. Includes a full tool reference generated from the live tools/list.

plugins.name: pingroom-cli
plugins.description: Reach a human from a shell, a CI pipeline, or a Claude Code hook with the @pingroom/cli: attachments up to 5 MiB, human answers as exit codes a script can branch on, and room, webhook and quick-action management.
